integrity: The theorem is proved structurally. Exhaustive computations on small homogeneous, mixed semisimple, and nonsemisimple modules are included only as boundary checks.
scientific_limitations: Uses the nonzero proper submodule convention for the intersection graph.
Restricted to finite modules over commutative rings; no infinite-cardinal extension is claimed.
title: Total domination of finite-module intersection graphs has a complete length-and-type classification
